resolutions.researcher_notes: Status 'operating' is inferential, not literal. OPEC ASB 2017 (data-year 2016), p.138 'Main gas pipelines in OPEC Members, 2016' lists 'Abqaiq/Shedgum, Saudi Aramco, 33, 42' as an existing in-service gas line (confirmed by pdfplumber extraction of the PDF; url_verifier flags the raw substring as the documented deflate-PDF false-negative, but liveness = 200). Corroborated by Aramco's own 'Master Gas System – fueling a nation' feature, which states the MGS has been operational since 1982 and continues to carry associated gas from Ghawar-area fields (Abqaiq/Shedgum). Two independent origins (OPEC survey + Aramco). No contradiction.

Fuel = Gas. OPEC ASB 2012 (data-year 2011) lists 'Abqaiq-B/Shedgum, Saudi Aramco, 33, 42' explicitly under the 'Gas pipelines in OPEC Members, 2011' table (pdfplumber-confirmed; PDF liveness 200, substring is a deflate-PDF false-negative). Independently, Fluor's Shedgum Gas Plant project page confirms Shedgum is a Saudi Aramco natural-gas processing plant, and this line is part of Aramco's Master Gas (natural gas) System. Two independent origins agree; no contradiction.

LengthKnown = 53.00 km. Both OPEC ASB editions give the length as '33' with the 2017 header explicitly labelling the column 'Length (miles)'. 33 miles = 53.1 km, matching the GEM value of 53.00 km exactly. Tier = medium (independent=false): two survey years but a single publisher (OPEC), so not two independent origins; no other public source states this segment's length. No contradiction — the mile-to-km conversion resolves the apparent numeric mismatch.

Diameter = 42 in. Both OPEC ASB editions (2012 data-2011 and 2017 data-2016) give diameter '42' for the Abqaiq-B/Shedgum line (2017 header explicitly 'Diameter (inches)'), matching GEM exactly. Tier = medium (independent=false): consistent across two editions but same publisher; no second independent origin found. No contradiction.

FuelSource = Abqaiq. The OPEC ASB connection name 'Abqaiq-B/Shedgum' explicitly identifies Abqaiq as the origin/source end of the line; Aramco's Master Gas System feature confirms Abqaiq is a gas-gathering/processing hub feeding the MGS. Two independent origins support the Abqaiq origin. Tier medium because 'FuelSource' is an interpretation of the connection endpoint rather than a field either source labels 'fuel source' verbatim.

Endpoints Abqaiq -> Shedgum, both in Saudi Arabia's Eastern Province. OPEC ASB 2017 names the connection 'Abqaiq/Shedgum' (both endpoints); Fluor's project page confirms the Shedgum Gas Plant is a Saudi Aramco facility in Saudi Arabia. Both Abqaiq and Shedgum are well-established Eastern Province facilities. Two independent origins for the start/end endpoints; the 'Eastern Province' administrative label is corroborated context (Abqaiq and Shedgum are both in the Eastern Province oil belt). No contradiction.

Owner = Saudi Aramco 100%. OPEC ASB 2012 explicitly lists 'Saudi Aramco' as owner/operator of the Abqaiq-B/Shedgum line; Fluor names Saudi Aramco as the owner of the Shedgum Gas Plant and its associated gas program. The entire Master Gas System is a wholly Saudi Aramco asset. Two independent origins agree on 100% Saudi Aramco ownership. No contradiction.
